title: R2-G2 Revision 3 transport boundary reconciliation and correction plan

sourceReplanCommit.message: docs: replan phase 7b external result boundary

activeFindings.semanticClaim: Host adapter serialization still traverses live external result objects before the generic boundary.
activeFindings.requiredCorrection: Remove live-result JSON.stringify from executeBoundToolOperation. Require the bound host executor operation to return a primitive serialized JSON string and reject non-string values before any property access, JSON.parse, schema validation, redaction, or byte calculation.

activeFindings.semanticClaim: Integration-specific serialized byte bounds are not meaningfully verified at each cited raw-response boundary.
activeFindings.requiredCorrection: Add focused oversized serialized-response assertions at the Context7, shadcn, and Codebase Memory service/transport boundaries, proving rejection before JSON.parse or normalization and proving no cache/persistence side effect.

revisedRootCause.statement: Revision 2 moved the generic converter to an inert serialized-text input, but the exported bound-operation dispatch still bridges typed executor results with JSON.stringify inside the generic adapter. That bridge is earlier than the string-only runtime check and can execute getter/Proxy/cycle-sensitive traversal. In parallel, the three integration parsers have raw UTF-8 guards but no integration-specific over-limit tests proving the guard precedes parse/normalization and side effects.

revision3CorrectionScope.scopeRule: Modify only the host serialized binding and focused boundary tests unless implementation evidence proves a contract declaration must be updated; do not change authority, agent catalog, skills, dependencies, workflows, runtime lifecycle, customer projects, or deployment.

preFixProof.callerSearch: No non-test production caller of executeBoundToolOperation was found. The API remains limited internal host dispatch, but runtime type forgery/custom executor injection is possible.

revision3CorrectionSteps: 1. Reconfirm the preserved candidate checksums and current baseline HEAD before editing; abort if any unexpected dirty path appears.

2. In adapters.ts, split the host tooling binding from typed agent/domain ports: BoundToolOperation executors for registered external-result operations must return Promise<string> serialized JSON text. Remove serializeHostNormalizedResult and do not JSON.stringify executor output in executeBoundToolOperation. Pass the primitive string directly to registeredOutputToToolResult. Keep authority selection and operation discriminants unchanged.

3. If a current production binding site is discovered, make that binding return serialized text from an integration-owned, schema-normalized result boundary; never add a generic unknown-to-string bridge in adapters. Repository evidence currently shows no non-test production caller, so do not invent a wiring file.

4. Keep registeredOutputToToolResult's runtime primitive check, UTF-8 bound before JSON.parse, schema/redaction/provenance behavior, and 16000-byte ToolResult context bound. Add a bound-operation test proving getter, Proxy, toJSON, iterator, and cyclic object attempts cause zero protected traps and fail before generic conversion; add a valid serialized binding success test.

5. Add the exact Context7 oversized serialized transport test at the service boundary. Assert the 200001-byte UTF-8 payload fails with the existing Context7 unavailable/limit error before normalization, cache write, and ToolResult conversion.

6. Add the exact shadcn oversized serialized transport test at the service boundary. Assert the 200001-byte UTF-8 payload fails with the existing shadcn content-limit/unavailable error before JSON.parse/normalize/schema/cache.

7. Add the exact Codebase Memory oversized injected-result service test. Assert the 200001-byte UTF-8 payload fails before normalize/cache/persistence. Also add the bounded child-process line test if the existing test harness can exercise the transport; otherwise record the service test and preserve the production line guard without a new framework.

8. Run deterministic focused tests, then the repository-required lint/typecheck/full deterministic gates, and capture source checksums and test evidence before reviewers. Do not run customer E2E, deployment, QA cleanup, or R2-G3.
9. Rerun the required reviewers once on current evidence. Close R2-G2 only if all required reviewers approve and no active finding remains; otherwise record BLOCKED and preserve the candidate.
postFixAcceptanceCriteria: No production executeBoundToolOperation path calls JSON.stringify on a caller-supplied executor result.
A bound executor result reaches registeredOutputToToolResult only as primitive serialized JSON text; object, Proxy, getter, toJSON, iterator, and cyclic values are rejected without protected traps.
The generic serialized UTF-8 bound occurs before JSON.parse; ToolResult data/text remains bounded at 16000 bytes and redaction/provenance remain intact.
Context7, shadcn, and Codebase Memory each reject an oversized serialized response before JSON.parse/normalization, and tests prove no cache/persistence mutation.
External content remains UNTRUSTED_EXTERNAL, advisory, redacted, and unable to affect authority, dependency scope, file scope, host context, or write permissions.
No new agent, skill, dependency, MCP, shell, AST, workflow, customer-project, deployment, or QA-cleanup behavior is introduced.
